title: Shedding
text: Shedding. Have not even put a pillow in it yet, it's already leaving spidery white threads all over navy blue sheets.

product_metadata.title: OJIA Deluxe Home Decorative Super Soft Plush Mongolian Faux Fur Throw Pillow Cover Cushion Case (18 x 18 Inch, Gradient Grey)
features: Size:12 x 20 Inch / 18 x 18 Inch / 20 X 20 Inch / 24 X 24 Inch. Pillow insert is not included.
Add a touch of graceful color to your bedroom or living room with this super soft mongolian faux fur pillow cover.
Made of soft faux Mongolian fur on one side, silky smooth polyester lining on the other side. Give a cozy feel to your living room and any seating area.
The pillow cover is made with color matching invisible zipper that allows easy insertion and removal of pillow inserts.
Washing Instruction: Machine Washable temperature maximum 80℉ / Dry Clean.
